sample_unit: questions (AI responses) reviewed by 7 subject matter experts

links.outcome: Expert-rated currency and completeness of Copilot's radiography clinical knowledge
links.effect: Experts flagged incomplete or superficial content and outdated terminology and standards, including shielding and grid use, in Copilot responses; no numeric rates reported.
links.quote: However, concerns were raised about incomplete or superficial content, attributions outside a radiologic technologist's scope of practice, outdated terminology and standards (including shielding and grid use), lack of specificity, and insufficient clinical context.

unlisted_practices: Embedding critical AI literacy skills into health professions curricula so students verify AI outputs

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and educational utility of Microsoft Copilot (GPT-4) responses to radiography examination questions evaluated by subject matter experts, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
